narr: Scattered thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to north-central Idaho, impacting the Elkhorn Fire burn scar. These heavy rains lead to flash flooding and debris flows.
ev: Radar and local mesonet observations indicate 0.75 to 1.00 inch of rain fell over 30 minutes across the Elkhorn burn scar. Large debris flows and scour paths occurred across the Salmon River Trail #096 for about 2.5 miles between Bargamin and Rattlesnake creeks. Multiple flow paths scoured at least 30 feet deep and 35 to 80 feet across where the trail crossed small draws.
